title: Integrate VisualRuleBuilder into PolicyPage as default editing tab
description:
**Bug**: VisualRuleBuilder.tsx exists but is dead code — never imported or rendered in PolicyPage.tsx.

PolicyPage.tsx Tab type is `"overview" | "rules" | "editor" | "simulator" | "snapshots"` — no "builder" tab. The "rules" tab renders `<RulesTable>`, not `<VisualRuleBuilder>`.

**Fix**:
1. Add "builder" to Tab type (or replace "rules")
2. Import VisualRuleBuilder in PolicyPage.tsx
3. Add a tab entry for "Builder" as the primary editing interface
4. Wire `activeTab === "builder"` to render `<VisualRuleBuilder bundleId={activeBundleId} />`
5. Make "builder" the default tab or ensure it's prominently placed

**Files**: `dashboard/src/pages/PolicyPage.tsx`

**Context**: The VisualRuleBuilder, RuleCard, and RuleEditor components are fully built — they just need wiring.
definitionOfDone: VisualRuleBuilder imported and rendered in PolicyPage.tsx
Builder tab is the default policy editing interface

implementationPlan.description: In PolicyPage.tsx: (1) Add 'builder' to Tab type union. (2) Add a 'Builder' tab entry with Layers icon positioned as the 3rd tab (after Rules). (3) Import VisualRuleBuilder from '../components/policy/VisualRuleBuilder'. (4) Add activeTab === 'builder' render branch that shows <VisualRuleBuilder /> with the active bundleId. (5) Change default tab from 'overview' to 'builder' to match the epic rail 'Visual rule builder is the DEFAULT view'. (6) Rename existing 'editor' tab label to 'YAML' to distinguish it from the visual builder.
implementationPlan.note: Added 'builder' to Tab type, imported VisualRuleBuilder and Blocks icon, added Builder tab entry (3rd position after Rules), renamed Editor tab to YAML, changed default tab to 'builder', added render branch for builder tab with VisualRuleBuilder component, updated RulesTable onSelectRule to navigate to builder instead of editor.
